items.title: Goldman Sachs Is Pulling Claude Code from Its Bankers and Traders
items.summary: Goldman Sachs has decided to withdraw access to Claude code from its bankers and traders, citing concerns over security and compliance. This move highlights the ongoing challenges financial institutions face in integrating AI technologies while maintaining regulatory standards.

items.title: Dux: Free, open-source Wayland desktop shell with file manager and theming
items.summary: Dux has been launched as a free and open-source Wayland desktop shell, featuring a built-in file manager and customizable theming options. This development provides developers with a new tool to enhance user experience on Linux systems, promoting further innovation in desktop environments.

items.title: Llama-modchip: 284B DeepSeek on 64GB RAM, no GPU
items.summary: The Llama-modchip project demonstrates the capability of running a 284 billion parameter model using only 64GB of RAM without a GPU. This breakthrough could significantly lower the barrier to entry for developers looking to experiment with large language models in resource-constrained environments.

items.title: Outlook.com Is Quietly Rejecting Email from Domains Without DMARC
items.summary: Outlook.com has begun rejecting emails from domains that do not implement DMARC, a move aimed at enhancing email security and reducing spam. Developers and system administrators should take note to ensure their email domains are properly configured to avoid delivery issues.

items.title: Nvidia Board of Directors Is Investigating Jensen Huang
items.summary: The Nvidia Board of Directors has initiated an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang, raising questions about corporate governance and leadership in the tech industry. This development could have significant implications for Nvidia's strategic direction and investor confidence.
